task: Implement local CLI commands that promote selected story decisions into durable decision docs with scope and freshness gates.
outcome: User runs `lattice decision_doc_proposal ...`, sees `Decision doc proposal DDP-001 saved`; runs `lattice decision_doc_preview ...`, sees the Markdown and target path; runs `lattice decision_doc_save ... --confirm`, sees `Decision doc saved to docs/requirements/decisions/<slug>.md`; stale or out-of-scope saves print BLOCKED-style errors.
facts: B-16eb added and quorum-reviewed docs/requirements/decisions/decision-doc-promotion-execution-plan.md as the implementation contract.
Existing decision_set writes .lattice story-local decision.json through packages/main/src/handlers/decision.ts and StoryStore read/write helpers.
Existing decision-doc quorum gate detects docs/requirements/decisions/*.md changes and requires local host_verdict quorum at DONE.
Command policies and process fact registry are hard runtime surfaces for lifecycle facts; new gate-relevant commands must be registered there and in scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.
Scope contract and checklist file declarations already provide path-level scope enforcement for lifecycle gates.
constraints: Do not directly read or write docs/story or packages/main/tests/fixtures.
First version supports only docs/requirements/decisions/*.md target paths.
decision_doc_save must not imply Authority receipt completion, authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, productionDone, customerKeyRef, or Layer4 support.
decision_doc_preview must be read-only and not mutate story metadata.
decision_doc_save must require confirm:true, explicit create/update mode, fresh proposal/source decision digest, and in-scope target path.
